    b = json.loads(json.dumps(base))

# ---- commodity issues
add(V.replace("\"source\":0,\"target\":1", "\"source\":1,\"target\":1"), True, "src==target")
add(V.replace("\"source\":0", "\"source\":3"), True, "source out of range")
add(V.replace("\"demand\":4", "\"demand\":-1"), True, "negative demand")

       "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":4},

       "commodities": [{"source":0,"target":3,"demand":1,"paths":[[0,1,2],[3,0,1,2]],"previous":[16,0]}],

add(json.dumps(b13), True, "path revisits node 0")

       "edges": [{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":2,"head":1,"capacity":4}],

add(json.dumps(b15), False, "valid path 0-1-2")

add(json.dumps(b16), True, "path starts with wrong tail (source 1, edge 2 is 1->0)")
# previous with zero demand but nonempty paths must sum to 16

def main():
    payload = b""
    for p, _, _ in CASES:
        assert b"\n" not in p, "payload has newline"
        payload += p + b"\n"
    # overlong line: 4MiB + 5, then a valid line -> must recover
    overlong = b" " * (4 * 1024 * 1024 + 5)
    payload2 = payload + overlong + b"\n" + V.encode() + b"\n"

                       input=payload2, capture_output=True, timeout=600)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[:3000]
    lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[:2000])
    exp = [("invalid" if e else None) for _, e, _ in CASES] + ["invalid", "not-invalid"]
    ok = 0
 fails = []
    if len(lines) != len(exp):
        print("LINE COUNT MISMATCH", len(lines), len(exp))

                print("FAIL(line %d, %s): expected invalid, got %s" % (i, note, ln[:300]))

                print("FAIL(line %d, %s): %s" % (i, note, ln[:200]))

            print("FAIL: overlong line not reported invalid")
        else:
            ok += 1
        if json.loads(lines[-1]).get("status") in ("optimal", "infeasible"):
            ok += 1
        else:
            print("FAIL: recovery after overlong failed:", lines[-1][:200])
    print("invalid-suite: %d/%d ok" % (ok, len(exp)))


main()
